# A small specification for the tests of the check

**REQ-AAA-001.** The first requirement of area AAA.

**REQ-AAA-002.** The second requirement of area AAA.

**REQ-BBB-001.** The only requirement of area BBB.

**REQ-AAA-001.** A repeated definition: the identifier is counted once.

An inline mention such as **REQ-ZZZ-009.** in the middle of a line is not a definition.
 **REQ-ZZZ-008.** An indented one is not a definition either.
